doc_discrepancies: D1: Raw CSV exporter emits UnitDamaged.csv, never Damage.csv.
D2: BS MQTT scalars are stringified (CH/CS/Count), entities have single-key wrappers, Scenario.Time is .NET ticks, events live under SimEvents/EventTriggers not Events.
D3: Real BS Q-077 frames arrive as whole-frame single messages (~0.8 MB @ ~9 Hz) with gunzipped BOM JSON.
D4: process_<sid> Status=0 observed after EndTime while stream keeps flowing; termination requires victory_<sid> / clock check.

D5: 5 ExportedEventType enums (SensorDetectionAttempt, PointDefenceAndDECM, WaterSplash, SimExecution, CargoTransfer) have zero call sites; WeaponImpact checks ExportExplosions; Explosion is missing from DBTablesDefine while UnitJammed..FirstSensorToUnitRecordCreated ARE in DBTablesDefine.
D6: F1Config/EventExport.ini is unused; real INI is EventExportExtra.ini; b_IsSchemeRun forces all CSV flags on while Bridge Run does not.
D7: Raw CSVs have double UTF-8 BOM; DB exporters drop fields and fail on Explosion / UnguidedWeapon UnitDestroyed / MySQL UnitCreate typo.
D8: Lua KeyValueStore throws on ':' in XML tag names (must use '.'); no ScenEdit_GetUnits() exists.
D9: BS MQTT publisher is not in CMO-netcore-src/ or F1_Console/.
